r2SourceEvidence.review_note: Wikipedia describes a prepalatial settlement at Knossos during approximately 3000–1900 BCE, and an Early Minoan I phase around 3100–2650 BCE; the Met gives Minoan Crete c. 3000–1100 BCE. This record describes an existing settlement, not its foundation, the construction of a palace, or an exact year. The coordinate is a modern reference point and the 20 km radius is a gameplay setting. Existing overlapping place entries and their misclassification need separate review.
